combination.zh: 常与 profile.token 组合。

description.en: Multi-session container semantics on one connection, including sibling-session isolation and connection-level CLOSE shutdown behavior.

combination.zh: 需同时声明 session.open_close。

description.en: Public operation lifecycle semantics including accepted, running, partial, waiting_tool, cancelled, failed, superseded, and completed states.

description.zh: single-operation、subtree、operation_group 与 whole-session 四类 cancel_scope 边界语义。
description.en: cancel_scope boundaries across single-operation, subtree, operation_group, and whole-session cancellation.

combination.zh: 常与 payload.typed 组合。

description.en: Derived from 3 cases. Round-trip the canonical SESSION_PATCH_ACK metadata without changing session recovery semantics. Run a real TCP session smoke test through the current NNRP/1 runtime. Run a real QUIC session smoke test through the current NNRP/1 runtime.

combination.en: Appears in multiple combined selections: session.resume; transport.tcp; transport.quic.

Validate RESULT_HINT metadata and reject unknown reason codes.
description.en: Derived from 4 cases. Round-trip the canonical FLOW_UPDATE packet and preserve scoped credit and retry metadata. Round-trip the canonical RESULT_HINT packet and preserve its budget and congestion fields. Validate FLOW_UPDATE routing, credit, retry-after, and flag semantics. Validate RESULT_HINT metadata and reject unknown reason codes.

description.en: Derived from 2 cases. Round-trip the canonical FRAME_SUBMIT metadata used by the current NNRP/1 submit path. Parse and emit FRAME_SUBMIT with typed payload and object-reference bookkeeping intact.

combination.zh: Also selected with payload.typed.

description.en: Derived from 3 cases. Round-trip the canonical RESULT_PUSH metadata, including status, result class, flags, and payload bookkeeping. Parse and emit RESULT_PUSH while preserving status, result class, flags, and typed-payload metadata. Resolve RESULT_PUSH object references or surface a protocol-shaped cache miss.

description.en: Parse and re-emit the current 24-byte typed payload descriptor with its explicit per-frame payload kind, schema binding, stream semantics, offset, and length.

combination.zh: 通常与 frame_submit.tensor.inline 同时声明。

description.en: Derived from 3 cases. Round-trip the canonical cache-backed object-reference block. Round-trip CACHE_PUT, CACHE_ACK, and CACHE_INVALIDATE metadata as one public cache lifecycle. Resolve RESULT_PUSH object references or surface a protocol-shaped cache miss.

combination.zh: Also selected with result_push.basic.

description.en: Derived from 3 cases. Round-trip TRANSPORT_PROBE and TRANSPORT_PROBE_ACK metadata. Select the ready transport from real probe observations and preserve deterministic fallback. Run a real TCP session smoke test through the current NNRP/1 runtime.

combination.en: Appears in multiple combined selections: transport.quic; session.open_close.

description.en: Derived from 3 cases. Round-trip TRANSPORT_PROBE and TRANSPORT_PROBE_ACK metadata. Select the ready transport from real probe observations and preserve deterministic fallback. Run a real QUIC session smoke test through the current NNRP/1 runtime.

combination.en: Appears in multiple combined selections: transport.tcp; session.open_close.

description.zh: 按操作标识取消或中止任务，并输出带 trace context 的类型化终态。
description.en: Cancel or abort an operation by id and emit a typed terminal state with trace context.

combination.zh: 通常与 control.result_drop_reason、control.trace_context 同时声明。
combination.en: Usually claimed with control.result_drop_reason and control.trace_context.

description.zh: 标记结果被丢弃的原因，覆盖取消、中止、过期、被替换等终态。
description.en: Marks why a result was dropped, including cancelled, aborted, expired, and superseded terminal states.

combination.zh: 会与取消、中止、优先级/截止时间、supersede 等控制帧组合出现。
combination.en: Appears with cancel/abort, priority/deadline, and supersede control frames.

description.zh: 在线路级保留端到端 trace context，用于分段计时和问题定位。
description.en: Preserves end-to-end trace context for segmented timing and diagnosis.

combination.zh: 通常与 control.cancel_abort、control.result_drop_reason 同时声明。
combination.en: Usually claimed with control.cancel_abort and control.result_drop_reason.

description.zh: 在操作生命周期中动态调整优先级，允许调度器重新排序未完成工作。
description.en: Dynamically updates operation priority so schedulers can reorder unfinished work.

combination.zh: 通常与 control.deadline_expire、control.result_drop_reason 同时声明。
combination.en: Usually claimed with control.deadline_expire and control.result_drop_reason.

description.zh: 声明任务截止时间或过期时间，避免服务端继续完成已经无意义的工作。
description.en: Declares task deadlines or expiry times so servers can stop stale work.

combination.zh: 通常与 control.priority_update、control.result_drop_reason 同时声明。
combination.en: Usually claimed with control.priority_update and control.result_drop_reason.

description.zh: 以更细粒度返回进度和部分结果，避免所有数据只能在终态一次性交付。
description.en: Returns progress and partial results at finer granularity instead of only at terminal completion.

combination.zh: 通常与 control.credit_backpressure 同时声明。

description.zh: 通过 credit update 与 backpressure 告知对端当前可接受的并发和数据量。
description.en: Uses credit updates and backpressure to signal accepted concurrency and data volume.

combination.zh: 通常与 control.progress_partial 同时声明。

description.zh: 在能力协商中声明成本、偏好、限制与降级元数据。
description.en: Negotiates capability cost, preference, limit, and downgrade metadata.

description.zh: 声明运行时对象、在操作中引用对象，并显式释放所有权。
description.en: Declares runtime objects, references them in operations, and releases ownership explicitly.

combination.zh: 会与 object.cost、object.ownership、object.delta 等对象能力组合出现。
combination.en: Appears with object.cost, object.ownership, and object.delta.

description.zh: 为运行时对象声明计算、显存、带宽或生命周期成本。
description.en: Declares compute, memory, bandwidth, or lifetime cost for runtime objects.

combination.zh: 通常与 object.lifecycle、object.ownership 同时声明。
combination.en: Usually claimed with object.lifecycle and object.ownership.

description.zh: 固定运行时对象的所有权转移、释放和失效语义。
description.en: Fixes ownership transfer, release, and invalidation semantics for runtime objects.

combination.zh: 通常与 object.lifecycle、object.cost 同时声明。
combination.en: Usually claimed with object.lifecycle and object.cost.

description.zh: 发送对象补丁或 delta，避免重复传输完整运行时对象。
description.en: Sends object patches or deltas without resending the full runtime object.

combination.zh: 通常与 object.lifecycle 同时声明。

description.zh: 携带路由与执行 hint，供 runtime 或 subagent 调度使用，避免退回重 JSON / protobuf 包装。
description.en: Carries route and execution hints for runtime or subagent scheduling without heavy JSON/protobuf wrappers.

description.zh: 正式化 cache reference、cache miss 和 invalidation，仅在身份与失效语义清晰的路径使用。
description.en: Formalizes cache references, cache misses, and invalidation where identity and invalidation are well-defined.

description.zh: 协商更便宜的执行 profile，允许在会话中降级计算或带宽策略。
description.en: Negotiates a cheaper execution profile during a session.

combination.zh: 通常与 control.budget_update 同时声明。

description.zh: 在会话中更新 compute、token、memory 或 bandwidth budget。
description.en: Updates compute, token, memory, or bandwidth budgets during a session.

combination.zh: 通常与 control.degrade_profile 同时声明。

description.zh: 用新操作替换过期操作，并保持 trace 连续性与迟到结果可丢弃语义。
description.en: Replaces obsolete operations while preserving trace continuity and droppable late-result semantics.

combination.zh: 通常与 control.result_drop_reason 同时声明。

description.zh: 区分可恢复错误与终止失败，并在需要时携带 retry-after 时间。
description.en: Distinguishes recoverable errors from terminal failures and carries retry-after timing when required.

title.zh: nnrp-1-preview4 线路级一致性测试

note.zh: 从线路级测试场景声明派生，覆盖 20 个由测试套件直接扮演客户端、服务端或代理的协议级场景。
note.en: Derived from wire-level conformance scenario manifests. Covers 20 protocol scenarios where the runner directly acts as client, server, or proxy.

scenarios.description: Runner sends the frozen OpenAI-compatible typed request directly, then validates raw partial-result JSON and a typed terminal result over a live endpoint.

summary.zh: 线路级测试场景会直接交换 NNRP 帧，并校验终态、关键帧和观测证据。
summary.en: Runner sends the frozen OpenAI-compatible typed request directly, then validates raw partial-result JSON and a typed terminal result over a live endpoint.

scenarios.description: Runner submits an operation, sends CANCEL, and verifies cooperative termination or a typed drop reason over the wire.

summary.zh: 提交操作后发送取消帧，并验证对端通过协作终止或结构化丢弃原因完成收敛。
summary.en: Runner submits an operation, sends CANCEL, and verifies cooperative termination or a typed drop reason over the wire.

scenarios.description: Runner sends DEADLINE before FRAME_SUBMIT with the same operation and frame identity, then verifies the target applies the reservation without an SDK adapter.

summary.zh: 线路级测试场景会直接交换 NNRP 帧，并校验终态、关键帧和观测证据。
summary.en: Runner sends DEADLINE before FRAME_SUBMIT with the same operation and frame identity, then verifies the target applies the reservation without an SDK adapter.

scenarios.description: Runner proxies an admitted operation, injects a priority update and deadline expiry, and verifies stale work is dropped instead of completed late.

summary.zh: 在代理路径注入优先级更新和过期时间，验证过期任务会被显式丢弃而不是迟到完成。
summary.en: Runner proxies an admitted operation, injects a priority update and deadline expiry, and verifies stale work is dropped instead of completed late.

scenarios.description: Runner accepts a client request, emits PROGRESS and PARTIAL_RESULT, constrains credits, and verifies the client respects backpressure.

summary.zh: 由测试套件扮演服务端，发送进度、部分结果和信用更新，验证客户端遵守背压。
summary.en: Runner accepts a client request, emits PROGRESS and PARTIAL_RESULT, constrains credits, and verifies the client respects backpressure.

scenarios.description: Runner negotiates costs, sends route and execution hints, references cache state, and verifies downgrade or cache miss behavior is explicit.

summary.zh: 协商能力成本并发送路由、执行和缓存提示，验证降级或缓存未命中会被显式返回。
summary.en: Runner negotiates costs, sends route and execution hints, references cache state, and verifies downgrade or cache miss behavior is explicit.

scenarios.description: Runner submits an operation over the Rust IPC transport, sends CANCEL, and verifies cooperative termination or a typed drop reason without falling back to an SDK adapter.

summary.zh: 提交操作后发送取消帧，并验证对端通过协作终止或结构化丢弃原因完成收敛。
summary.en: Runner submits an operation over the Rust IPC transport, sends CANCEL, and verifies cooperative termination or a typed drop reason without falling back to an SDK adapter.

scenarios.description: Runner accepts a WebSocket transport request, emits PROGRESS and PARTIAL_RESULT frames, constrains credits, and verifies the client honors backpressure without using a transport-local JSON shim.

summary.zh: 由测试套件扮演服务端，发送进度、部分结果和信用更新，验证客户端遵守背压。
summary.en: Runner accepts a WebSocket transport request, emits PROGRESS and PARTIAL_RESULT frames, constrains credits, and verifies the client honors backpressure without using a transport-local JSON shim.
